description: Lists the TCP/IP fingerprint presets a mobile or server proxy can present at the network layer (Android, iPhone, Windows, macOS, Linux…), for making the OS signature of proxied traffic consistent with the client device. set_tcp_fingerprint applies one.

include_details.description: Also return the raw profile_json (TTL, MSS, window, options)

name: list_tcp_profiles
title: List TCP fingerprint profiles
